episode_event_pm1003_00_00/6801_1001_200:
When people and Pokémon gather in large
numbers, their feelings all bubble to the
surface.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/6801_1001_300:
It is at these places of amusement I may
discover material for my research!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_100:
Courtney, lower the gauges’ pressure a bit
more!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_400: We can’t have it wielding its power at will.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_500:
I assume that’s why you’re attempting to
restrain it using a scientific approach.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_700:
Mr. Clavell, thank you again for allowing us
to borrow a room at the academy.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_800:
Of course. After all, it’s for the Pokémon’s
sake as well.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_900: If I may ask a favor in return...
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_100:
We have some people who would like to
observe. Would that be permissible?
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_130: Heard you got a tough Pokémon here.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_140: I just had to come see it for myself!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_150:
I...I want to witness Team Magma’s amazing
technology...
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_170:
So you’re trying to use gauges to determine
its body structure...
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_180:
and to measure how and when it generates
power!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_190:
Oh? I’m impressed you ascertained all that
with one look.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_210:
How would you like to join Team Magma’s
technology unit?
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_240:
Our boss is interested in her skills, too,
y’know.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_250:
If you’re looking to recruit her, you’ll have to
talk to ol’ Rika here first.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_260:
I see... Sounds likely to be a vexing
negotiation, then.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_270:
Dang. Not only did you give us permission
to observe—you also listen to reason.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_280:
I see why that ruinous Pokémon formed a
sync pair with you!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_290:
Be that as it may, I remain unsure whether
to welcome our chance encounter.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_310:
The two ruinous Pokémon that appeared
before Team Magma and Team Aqua...
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_320:
I suspect they were drawn here by
something.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_340: You could call it a point of commonality.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_350:
Both Archie and I could also be referred to
as “ruinous.”
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_360:
I suspect that quality somehow resonated
with these Pokémon.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_390:
Now that we are a sync pair, I shall not use
Ting-Lu for ruinous purposes.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_400:
I will prove powers of ruin may also be
used for salvation.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_420:
I cannot undo the past, but I’ve learned
much from my failures.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_430:
At the very least, I intend to use this power
to make a positive contribution to the world.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_460:
I like your mettle! You’ve got ol’ Rika’s
support, too!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_480: I see. Then there’s something I’d like to ask.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4001_1001_490:
Truthfully, for a new approach, I was
considering using Terastallization...
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_200:
You sure got the hang of Terastallization
quick!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_300:
Only thanks to you two and your remarkable
tutelage.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_400:
I feel I understand Ting-Lu better now—
perhaps because we undertook this training
together.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_500:
I can even comprehend the fear emanating
from its body.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_800:
Ting-Lu was created when fear poured into
an ancient ritual vessel clad itself in rocks
and dirt.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_900:
When I hear the word “fear,” it reminds me
of when I was afraid of being alone...
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_100:
I would hate for a Pokémon to go through
something like that.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_120:
No matter what happens, please stay by
Ting-Lu’s side.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_140:
At times, others’ support can empower one
to overcome great hardships.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_150: Ting-Lu... No matter what ruin you bring...
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_160: I shall face it with you—as your partner!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_180:
It seems the two of us are already one step
ahead of you.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_200:
Sounds like Archie and Wo-Chien became
friends at the Midnight Parade.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_220:
But Archie would never participate in such
an event!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_230: Nahahaha! The other team’s impressive, too!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_250:
I have no idea how Ting-Lu will change in a
lively environment.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4002_1001_260:
What do you say we join as well, as part of
our research?
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4003_1001_300:
Hmph! I’m sure it pales in comparison to
Team Magma’s.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4003_1001_400:
Some confidence you got there. Then let’s
make it a contest!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4003_1001_500:
Whoever hands out the most candy is the
Midnight Parade’s true star!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4003_1001_800: Rika! Penny! Let’s get started as well!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4003_1001_900: Allow us to show you our power!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4004_1001_200:
Those are the legends surrounding the
treasures of ruin...
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4004_1001_300:
and the full picture of the feud that took
place on Pasio.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4004_1001_400:
I encourage you to form your own
interpretations.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4004_1001_500: Both power and Pokémon simply exist.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4004_1001_600:
Will we make them our ruin? Or our
salvation?
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4004_1001_700:
To find out, we must keep a close eye on
how Pasio progresses.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4005_1001_100:
As those recognized by the powers of ruin,
we’ve one thing we must do.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4005_1001_200:
Indeed. We must never use ruinous power
for evil—or allow others to do so.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4005_1001_300:
That blasted Ghetsis... As usual, he’ll do as
he pleases!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4005_1001_400:
I’d rather not think about it, but it’s possible
one of us will stray as well.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4005_1001_500:
We must keep an eye on one another,
so as not to shatter Pasio’s balance.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4006_1001_100:
Yes... Keep playing “friends” while you
still can.
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4006_1001_200:
Before long, every last treasure of ruin will
be mine!
episode_event_pm1003_00_00/4006_1001_300: It is I who shall have the last laugh!
